content.title: Recap: Michigan State comes back, still falls to UConn in Sweet 16
content.text: March 27, 2026Updated March 28, 2026, 6:02 a.m. ETMichigan State plays an NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 game against UConn on Friday at 9:45 p.m. at the Capital One Arena in Washington (CBS). Follow the game here with live updates from Detroit News contributor Andrew Graham. UConn outlasts Michigan State comeback attempt in Sweet 16 winMichigan State trailed by as many as 19 points and came back to lead by one in the second half, but ultimately fell to UConn, 67-63, in the Sweet 16 on Friday night. The Spartans (27-8) opened the game ice cold offensively, scoring six points across the first nine minutes, with just two made field goals, before eventually waking up and cutting into the lead. UConn (32-5) led 25-6 at one point but led by just eight points going into halftime. And in the second half, the Spartans stormed out of the gates to make it a game, eventually going ahead, 45-44, capping off a 39-19 extended run of play. But that was the high water mark for MSU, as the Huskies reestablished control and eked out just enough plays to get the win and end the Spartans’ season in the Sweet 16. With the win, UConn moves on to face No. 1 overall seed Duke in the Elite 8. Michigan State got 14 points from Carson Cooper in what turned out to be a balanced offensive effort across the board. Coen Carr and Jeremy Fears each added 13 points, and Jaxon Kohler had 12. Fears had seven assists to four turnovers. UConn’s big-ticket players showed up, as Tarris Reed Jr., the former Michigan big man, and Alex Karaban led the charge. Reed finished with 20 points and Karaban had 17 to go with seven rebounds. MSU down 4, situation direCooper missed the second free throw, UConn rebounded and MSU fouled immediately. The Huskies cashed both free throws and now lead, 67-63, with 4.0 to play. Tom Izzo takes his final timeout. MSU down 2 with 4.6 seconds to playDown 3, the Spartans ran a long offensive possession before a foul on a rebound sent Carson Cooper to the line. He made the first, making the score 65-63, and Dan Hurley takes timeout with 4.6 seconds to play. UConn up in final minute vs. MSUThe teams traded 3s heading into the final minute, putting UConn up 61-60, after Alex Karaban and Jeremy Fears buried shots from deep.UConn big man Tarris Reed Jr. makes a pair of free throws to put UConn up 63-60 with 44.8 to play. Tom Izzo takes timeout with 41.5 to go. UConn up 3 with 3:08 to play vs. MSUThe Spartans are down a bucket, and it'll be UConn inbounding from the baseline on the offensive end after the media timeout. The Huskies lead, 58-55, with 3:08 to play.Jaxon Kohler, Carson Cooper and Coen Carr are all in double figures for Michigan State. UConn back in front vs. MSU with 5 minutes to goThe Spartans took a momentary lead but the Huskies reestablished control to go up by a handful with around five minutes left. Michigan State takes lead in 2nd half vs. UConnWith a made basket and the conversion on the and-1 attempt, Jaxon Kohler has put MSU ahead for the first time since the Spartans led 4-3 in the first minutes of the game.It's a remarkable claw back, taking a 45-44 lead after trailing, 25-6 — a 39-19 extended run for the Spartans. Michigan State has made it a game vs. UConnIt looked like Michigan State was about to get played off the court in the Sweet 16, going down 25-6 to UConn at one point in the first half.But a Tom Izzo coached team did what it so often does in March, and gritted its teeth to get within one early. inthe second half and trail 44-40 at the under 12 timeout. Watch Coen Carr's emphatic blockThe junior came out of nowhere to swat away this UConn shot. However, the Spartans still trail early in the second half. Spartans open 2nd half on tear vs. UConnMichigan State has scored seven straight points to open the second half, four of them by Coen Carr, but the junior wing missed an and-1 opportunity to tie the game. Instead MSU gives up a 3 on the other end for UConn's first points of the half, and it's 38-34 Huskies.Carr also had a vicious block during the early sequence for MSU. Michigan State winnows UConn lead at halfAfter a horrid start to the game, MSU trails UConn 35-27 at halftime. Given the Spartans trailed by as many as 19 points in the first half, it's a good way for Michigan State to close out the half.Jaxon Kohler has nine points to lead the Spartans and all scorers, while UConn has gotten a balanced effort, led by eight points each by Solo Ball and Tarris Reed Jr. Gap remains for MSU vs. UConn in 1st halfMichigan State is up to 18 points, and the offense has started to perk up with the help of a few transition buckets. But the Huskies are still leading by 15, and are showing no signs of slowing much on offense as Tarris Reed Jr. gets fouled on a make and will shoot for the and-1 after the under 4 media timeout in the first half.UConn leads, 33-18. Spartans waking up, still trail UConnMichigan State has woken up on offense, scoring six points in about four minutes after scoring that many in the five nine. It's still not making much of a dent, as the Huskies are up by 15, leading 27-12.UConn is shooting 59 percent from the field and a blistering 6-for-7 from beyond the 3 point arc to open. MSU AWOL on offenseThe Spartans have two made field goals and have scored six points in nine minutes of game time. The Spartans are 2-of-15 from the field and 0-of-4 from behind the arc. UConn building big run vs. MSUAfter going down 4-3 early, the Huskies have rolled out to a 15-2 run as the Spartans have gone more than six minutes of game clock without a made field goal.Solomon Ball canned a 3 for the Huskies with 11:58 left and spurred a Tom Izzo timeout. UConn is up, 18-6, as Michigan State flounders on the offensive end. UConn out to early lead vs. MSUA pair of made 3s and a couple of twos — including a thunderous dunk by former Michigan big Tarris Reed Jr. — have the Huskies up, 8-4, at the under 16 timeout. Coen Carr will head to the free throw line for the Spartans after the media timeout, looking to get on the score sheet.So far, UConn has played with a bit more assertiveness on the offensive, and the Spartans are still searching for a flow. In about five minutes of gameplay, MSU has two made field goals. MSU vs. UConn tipoff pushed 10 minutesWith Duke's win over St. John's in the earlier game running until about 9:25 p.m., it will be about 30 minutes until the Spartans and Huskies get going, with tipoff now approximately set for 9:55 p.m. ET. Michigan State-UConn winner to face Duke in Elite 8St. John's led No. 1 overall seed Duke at halftime, but the Blue Devils proved to be too much down the stretch, clinging on for a 80-75 win over the Johnnies in the Sweet 16.Michigan State in 1-3 against Duke in the NCAA Tournament, and UConn is 2-2 against the Blue Devils in the tournament.NCAA TournamentNO. 3 MICHIGAN STATE VS. NO. 2 UCONN▶ What: Sweet 16 NCAA Tournament game▶ When: Friday, 9:45 p.m.▶ Where: Capital One Arena, Washington▶ TV: CBS▶ Records: Michigan State 27-7, UConn 31-5
